data.spiritual_meaning: Dorotheus expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dorotheus total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_latin.name: Dorotheus

in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorotheus a Graeco derivatum est, Dorotheus a Doron, quod Donum significat, et Theos, Deus. Hoc nomen significat quod Deus donavit sapientiam aut virtutem.
